Title: Seismix 1 Evara
Sub Title: Compact, stylish subwoofer from the Evara range
Product Description:
Part of Krix's contemporary Evara line, the Seismix 1 Evara is a compact down-firing active subwoofer that delivers deep bass without dominating a room, suited to apartments and smaller living spaces. It blends Krix acoustic engineering with a modern matte finish in multiple colourways.

  • Down-firing active subwoofer with compact footprint

  • Auto-sensing power, phase and filter adjustment, stereo RCA inputs

  • Matte finishes; Australian Made

Title: Equinox Evara
Sub Title: Big sound, small footprint - contemporary-finish Equinox
Product Description:
The Equinox Evara is a redesigned, contemporary-finish edition of the Equinox bookshelf with modern cabinet finishes and precision magnetic grilles. Krix states it delivers the same acoustic performance as the Equinox Mk5.

  • Contemporary-finish edition of the Equinox bookshelf

  • 130mm bass/midrange and 26mm dual-concentric tweeter

  • Performance matches the Equinox Mk5

Title: MX-20 Mk2
Sub Title: Next-gen 2-way modular behind-screen system
Product Description:
The MX-20 Mk2 is an upgraded modular front-wall cinema system that flush-mounts into a false wall behind an acoustically transparent screen. All modules are upgraded over the original MX-20 with a larger bass driver and constant-directivity horn. Pairs with the Cyclonix 15 supporting subwoofer.

  • Upgraded modular behind-screen LCR system

  • New 12-inch LF driver with 2.5-inch voice coil

  • Patented constant-directivity horn with 1-inch compression driver

Title: MX-30i
Sub Title: MX-30 modular system with new 18-inch infrasonic subwoofer modules
Product Description:
The MX-30i is the award-winning MX-30 modular behind-screen system updated with new high-performance 18-inch infrasonic subwoofer modules for true infrasonic reproduction. Five same-height, slim-depth modules install in a single wall cavity behind an acoustically transparent screen, for medium-to-large dedicated cinemas.

  • Five same-height modules for single-cavity behind-screen install

  • Mains with 380mm high-stiffness paper-cone mid-bass and constant-directivity horn

  • New high-performance 18-inch infrasonic subwoofer modules (reversible dual-terminal)

Title: MX-40i
Sub Title: Flagship 3-way modular system with 18-inch infrasonic subwoofer modules
Product Description:
The MX-40i is Krix's flagship modular behind-screen cinema system, combining a patented constant-directivity horn with newly engineered high-output 18-inch subwoofer modules for infrasonic reproduction. Five same-height, slim-line modules install in a single cavity for medium-to-large private cinemas.

  • Flagship 3-way modular behind-screen system

  • New high-performance 18-inch LF infrasonic driver

  • Reversible dual-terminal subwoofer cabinet

Title: MXi-118
Sub Title: Single-18-inch infrasonic subwoofer module for MX-30i / MX-40i
Product Description:
The MXi-118 is a single 18-inch infra-bass module that integrates into MX-30i and MX-40i modular cinema systems to add low-frequency power and deeper extension, or installs independently (including on a rear wall). Dual-terminal reversible cabinets allow vertical or horizontal placement, matching the height and slim depth of the MX LCR modules. Requires an approved amplifier with DSP.

  • Single 18-inch infra-bass module for MX-30i/MX-40i or standalone use

  • Reversible dual-terminal cabinet for flexible orientation

  • Requires an approved amplifier with DSP

Title: UCX-218
Sub Title: Flagship dual-18-inch passive infrasonic subwoofer
Product Description:
The UCX-218 is Krix's most powerful subwoofer, with dual 18-inch high-excursion drivers in a dual-opposing configuration that counteracts mechanical vibration. It brings commercial-cinema low-frequency performance into residential spaces with enormous headroom, reaching true infrasonic levels. Made in Australia and delivered in three modules.

  • Dual 18-inch high-excursion drivers in a dual-opposing configuration

  • Reaches true infrasonic levels with commercial-cinema headroom

  • Positionable horizontally or vertically; delivered in three modules

Title: AS-315
Sub Title: 315mm absorption / bass-trap spacer for MX-5 and MX-10
Product Description:
The AS-315 is a modular acoustic absorption spacer module sized for MX-5 and MX-10 systems. Positioned between the main speakers and subwoofers, it absorbs reflections and acts as a bass trap to recreate Krix's infinite-baffle wall. Supplied in pairs for symmetry.

  • Acoustic absorption / bass-trap spacer module

  • Sized for MX-5 and MX-10 systems

  • Supplied in pairs

Title: Banana Plugs
Sub Title: Gold-plated screw-clamp banana connectors
Product Description:
High-quality gold-plated banana connectors with two clamping screws for a secure connection to speaker terminals.

  • Gold-plated for low-resistance connections

  • Two clamping screws per plug

  • Suits 18 AWG to 10 AWG wire (conductors up to approximately 3mm)

Title: KX-4010
Sub Title: Single-18-inch passive cinema subwoofer for behind-screen placement
Product Description:
The KX-4010 is a passive high-performance commercial-cinema subwoofer with a single 18-inch driver. Its enclosure depth matches Krix screen systems to aid behind-screen positioning, and it is designed for maximum SPL down to 28Hz while reducing cone excursion in the pass band. Measured per AES2-2012 and Dolby Atmos calculator compatible.

  • Single 18-inch passive cinema subwoofer

  • Depth matches Krix screen systems for behind-screen placement

  • AES2-2012 measured, Dolby Atmos calculator compatible

Title: KX-4210
Sub Title: Dual-15-inch passive cinema subwoofer for Dolby Atmos
Product Description:
The KX-4210 is a passive high-performance commercial-cinema subwoofer with dual 15-inch drivers, specifically intended for Dolby Atmos cinemas where high maximum SPL is required to meet surround requirements.

  • Dual 15-inch passive cinema subwoofer

  • Developed to meet Dolby Atmos surround SPL requirements

Title: KX-4240
Sub Title: Triple-15-inch passive cinema subwoofer for Dolby Atmos
Product Description:
The KX-4240 is a passive high-performance commercial-cinema subwoofer with triple 15-inch drivers, intended for Dolby Atmos cinemas where very high maximum SPL is required.

  • Triple 15-inch passive cinema subwoofer

  • Developed for Dolby Atmos surround output

Title: KX-4290
Sub Title: Dolby Atmos surround subwoofer
Product Description:
The KX-4290 is a commercial-cinema Dolby Atmos surround subwoofer designed for use in Dolby Atmos cinema installations.

  • Commercial-cinema Dolby Atmos surround subwoofer

Title: KX-4605
Sub Title: Lowline dual-18-inch passive cinema subwoofer
Product Description:
The KX-4605 is a passive high-performance commercial-cinema subwoofer with dual 18-inch drivers in a lowline format suited to under-screen placement. The bass driver uses a 3-inch voice coil and large aggregate vent area for efficient low-frequency output at high power with minimal power compression and vent noise.

  • Dual 18-inch lowline cinema subwoofer

  • 3-inch voice coil bass driver

  • Large aggregate vent area for low power compression

Title: KX-4610
Sub Title: Lowline dual-18-inch passive cinema subwoofer
Product Description:
The KX-4610 is a passive high-performance commercial-cinema subwoofer with dual 18-inch drivers in a lowline-format enclosure, ideally suited to being positioned under the screen. Measured per AES2-2012 and Dolby Atmos calculator compatible.

  • Dual 18-inch lowline cinema subwoofer

  • Ideal for under-screen placement

  • AES2-2012 measured, Dolby Atmos calculator compatible

Title: KX-4610S
Sub Title: Slimline dual-18-inch passive cinema subwoofer for behind-screen placement
Product Description:
The KX-4610S is the slimline version of the KX-4610 passive commercial-cinema subwoofer, with dual 18-inch drivers and a depth equal to Krix screen systems to aid positioning behind the screen.

  • Dual 18-inch slimline cinema subwoofer

  • Depth matches Krix screen systems for behind-screen placement

Title: KX-5910
Sub Title: 3-way cinema screen channel with dedicated midrange horn
Product Description:
The KX-5910 is a 3-way commercial-cinema screen channel with a dedicated midrange horn driven by a low-distortion 6-inch neodymium driver for dialogue intelligibility, in a mitred bass enclosure with Krix X-Bracing. Available in tri-amp (.T) and bi-amp (.B) crossover variants. Recommended maximum room depth 13m.

  • 3-way horn-loaded cinema screen channel

  • Dedicated midrange horn for dialogue intelligibility

  • X-braced bass enclosure; .T and .B variants

Title: KX-5920
Sub Title: 3-way cinema screen system with dedicated midrange horn
Product Description:
The KX-5920 is a 3-way commercial-cinema screen system shipped in two parts - a KX-2610 low-frequency component and a KX-3910 horn-system component. A dedicated midrange horn reproduces the vocal band for dialogue intelligibility.

  • 3-way cinema screen system (two-part: KX-2610 LF + KX-3910 horn)

  • Dedicated midrange horn for vocal-band clarity

Title: KX-5610
Sub Title: Compact 3-way cinema screen channel
Product Description:
The KX-5610 is a compact 3-way commercial-cinema screen channel with discrete LF, MF and HF sections, available in a bi-amp (.B) crossover variant.

  • Compact 3-way cinema screen channel

  • Discrete LF/MF/HF sections

Title: KX-5720
Sub Title: Tilt-ready 3-way screen speaker for LED and solid-screen cinemas
Product Description:
The KX-5720 is a compact, tilt-ready 3-way commercial-cinema screen speaker designed for solid-screen and LED cinemas, with a tapered, slim enclosure for placement above or below the screen. It uses true constant-directivity high and midrange horns for precise localisation and even coverage.

  • Tilt-ready 3-way screen speaker for above/below-screen install

  • Designed for LED and solid-screen cinemas

  • True constant-directivity high and midrange horns

Title: KX-5285
Sub Title: High-output 2-way cinema screen system with triple 15-inch bass
Product Description:
The KX-5285 is a high-output 2-way commercial-cinema screen system shipped in two parts - a KX-2640 low-frequency component and a KX-3250 horn-system component. It pairs triple 15-inch bass drivers with a 4-inch voice-coil compression driver on a Krix 90x40 constant-directivity horn, in an X-braced enclosure.

  • High-output 2-way cinema screen system (two-part: KX-2640 LF + KX-3250 horn)

  • Triple 15-inch bass drivers

  • 4-inch compression driver on 90x40 constant-directivity horn

Title: KX-5976
Sub Title: 4-way (Quatrix) cinema screen system with UHF horn
Product Description:
The KX-5976 is a 4-way Quatrix commercial-cinema screen system with an X-bracing low-frequency enclosure and a UHF horn for high-frequency pattern control and extension, keeping all drivers within their piston range for dialogue intelligibility.

  • 4-way Quatrix cinema screen system

  • UHF horn for HF pattern control and extension

  • X-braced low-frequency enclosure

Title: KX-5986
Sub Title: 4-way (Quatrix) cinema screen system with UHF horn
Product Description:
The KX-5986 is a 4-way Quatrix commercial-cinema screen system with X-bracing and a UHF horn for improved high-frequency pattern control and extension. Offered in bi-amp (.B), tri-amp (.T) and full quad-amp (.Q) crossover variants.

  • 4-way Quatrix cinema screen system

  • UHF horn for HF pattern control

  • Bi-amp (.B), tri-amp (.T) and quad-amp (.Q) variants

Title: KX-5996
Sub Title: Flagship 4-way (Quatrix) cinema screen channel
Product Description:
The KX-5996 is one of the largest 4-way Quatrix screen channel speakers Krix has developed, adding an ultra-high-frequency horn to the patented horn arrays so all drivers operate within their piston range. Patented constant-directivity horn technology provides precision coverage. Offered as tri-amp (.T) and quad-amp (.Q).

  • Flagship 4-way Quatrix cinema screen channel

  • Adds a UHF horn so all drivers stay in their piston range

  • Patented constant-directivity horns; .T and .Q variants

Title: KX-1155
Sub Title: High-output horn-loaded cinema surround for Dolby Atmos
Product Description:
The KX-1155 is a high-output commercial-cinema surround with a true horn-loaded HF section using a patented constant-directivity HF horn coupled to a 1.75-inch voice-coil compression driver, plus dual 15-inch bass drivers. Developed to meet Dolby Atmos surround output requirements, with a 15-degree baffle angle.

  • High-output horn-loaded cinema surround

  • Patented constant-directivity HF horn with compression driver

  • Dual 15-inch bass drivers; developed for Dolby Atmos

Title: KX-1152
Sub Title: Single-15-inch horn-loaded cinema surround
Product Description:
The KX-1152 is a commercial-cinema surround pairing a 35mm (1.4-inch) compression driver on a 90x40 constant-directivity horn with a single 15-inch bass driver, in an X-braced vented B4 enclosure tuned to 40Hz.

  • Single 15-inch horn-loaded cinema surround

  • 1.4-inch compression driver on 90x40 constant-directivity horn

  • X-braced vented B4 enclosure tuned to 40Hz

Title: KX-1470
Sub Title: Compact high-power-handling single-8-inch cinema surround
Product Description:
The KX-1470 is a compact commercial-cinema surround in a braced, critically damped cabinet with a 15-degree angled front baffle to optimise coverage and reduce ceiling reflections. It uses a single 8-inch bass driver with a 1.5-inch voice coil, and includes wall-mount provision.

  • Compact high-power-handling cinema surround

  • 15-degree angled baffle for coverage control

  • Single 8-inch bass driver; wall-mount provision
